1. packages/features/bookings/components/PeopleFilter.tsx — `useEffect` calling `pushItemToKey("userIds", me.id)` creates an infinite/unstable render loop risk: `query.userIds` is derived from the URL query object which is typically a new array/object reference on every render, and `pushItemToKey` likely isn't memoized by identity across renders either. With `query.userIds` and `pushItemToKey` in the deps array, this can re-fire the effect (and re-push the router query) repeatedly, causing router churn, extra re-renders, or flicker. Fix: derive the "no filter set" condition from a stable primitive (e.g. `query.userIds?.length ?? 0`) and depend only on primitives (`isAdmin`, `me?.id`, `query.userIds?.length`), not on the array/function references; verify `useFilterQuery`'s returned callbacks are memoized before relying on them in a dep array.

2. packages/features/bookings/components/PeopleFilter.tsx — The "default to self" behavior is silent: nothing in the UI tells the admin that the list has been auto-filtered to just them. A user who lands on Bookings, sees few/no results, and doesn't notice the filter pill may think bookings are missing/broken. Fix: add a visible indicator (e.g. a toast, inline hint, or distinct styling on the filter chip) communicating "showing only your bookings" the first time this auto-filter is applied.

3. packages/features/bookings/components/PeopleFilter.tsx — Scope/placement concern: this component only renders the filter UI; the actual bookings list query (wherever it reads `userIds` from the URL, likely a separate component/page) is not shown in the diff. If that query path has its own default-fetch behavior independent of this filter's mount timing, there could be a race where the first bookings fetch runs with no `userIds` filter before this effect fires and pushes the param, briefly showing all users' bookings before narrowing. Fix: either set the default filter upstream (e.g. in the router/query initialization or server-side) rather than via a client-side effect reacting after mount, or confirm/document that the bookings query only runs after `query` resolves so there's no flash of unfiltered data.

4. packages/features/bookings/components/PeopleFilter.tsx — No distinction between org-level admin/owner (`currentOrg?.user.role`) and the different concept of a platform/system admin referenced by the linked issue (#18026, "admin bookings"). The PR title says "admin bookings" but reuses `isAdmin` which here means org admin/owner, not instance-level admin. If the intent per the issue is about instance admins (e.g. `/settings/admin` impersonation-style views), this is the wrong role check entirely. Fix: confirm against issue #18026 which "admin" is meant, and use the correct role/permission check (e.g. a platform admin flag) if that's the actual target, not `currentOrg` org-role.

5. packages/features/bookings/components/PeopleFilter.tsx — No test coverage added for this new default-filtering behavior (PR description only claims "verified through code review"/"confirmed type safety", not actual execution or tests). Given this changes default visible data for all admin users, this needs at least a unit/component test asserting: (a) filter auto-applies for admin with no existing filter, (b) it does not override an existing non-empty `userIds` filter, (c) it does not apply for non-admins. Fix: add tests before merging given the user-facing behavior change and blast radius (affects every admin's default view).
